bullets.title: META: Muse AI agent drives record +11% gain; JPM reiterates OW at $820 PT; Mizuho OW $750
bullets.body: Meta surged 11-12% on Monday—its largest non-earnings move in ~17 months—after Muse topped 2.5M downloads, hit #1 on Apple App Store, and opened developer connectors within 13 days of launch. JPMorgan reiterates Overweight with $820 PT, modeling agent-to-agent monetization at scale; Mizuho maintains Outperform at $750 PT (22x '27E P/E vs GOOGL at 30x during peak Gemini); Hedgeye raised to bullish TREND. META call volume hit 1.8M contracts—highest since Oct 2022. Meta Connect (Sept 23-24) is next catalyst; Watermelon model release likely delayed post-Connect. Amazon has blocked Muse access; Shopify integrated Muse checkout via Shop Pay, signaling commerce monetization path.

bullets.title: AMD hits $1T market cap; INTC +12%, ARM +17% on agentic CPU demand narrative
bullets.body: AMD crossed $1 trillion market cap for the first time (Lisa Su first female CEO of a $1T company) on Monday's +10% session, while INTC surged 12%+ and ARM +17% on the thesis that agentic AI inference workloads require 3-4 CPUs per GPU vs. 7-8 in training. UBS estimates suggest Muse at 100M users would need 1.58M AMD Ryzen CPUs. UBS cut CY27 PC units to -4% YoY and smartphone sell-in to -3% YoY on memory inflation. Pre-market Tuesday: ALAB -1.9%, CRDO -2.0%, COHR -1.9%, AMD -1.5% as semis give back some gains.

bullets.title: MSFT: Opco raises PT to $570 on Azure +46% growth; self-developed AI chips in 2027 mass production
bullets.body: Oppenheimer raises MSFT to $570 on 1Q Azure growth of 46% CC (~100bps above guidance) with 2Q potentially approaching 50%; demand outstrips available AI capacity. Separately, Microsoft Taiwan is on track for 2027 mass production of self-developed AI chips and doubled Taiwan AI data center plan to four facilities. Hedgeye and Hedgeye flags MSFT as bullish TREND breakout.

bullets.title: NVDA: RACK forecast raised to 80K in 2026 but still can't break out amid AI skepticism
bullets.body: UBS raises 2026 NVDA rack forecast by 2,500 to 80K and holds 95K for 2027. CoWoS industry capacity raised to 270kwpm by end-2027E from 160kwpm end-2026E. Despite AI momentum, NVDA trades at 17x and is described as struggling to break out amid lingering AI capex skepticism. NVDA CEOs Huang, Cook (AAPL), and Nadella (MSFT) attending Sept 24 White House state dinner for Xi Jinping.

bullets.title: PSKY: Morgan Stanley raises PT to $11.50 (OW); deal closes in ~2 weeks, $6B synergy intact
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight on PSKY and raises PT to $11.50, noting settlement includes no forced divestitures, preserving the $6B synergy opportunity (~11% of opex). Deal avoids a $7M/day ticking fee that would start Oct. 1. Combined HBO+Paramount+ pathway to 240M+ subs; pro-forma entity at ~7-8x synergized EV/EBITDA with $70B+ revs and $8B+ FCF target by 2030. Wolfe is more cautious, valuing combined entity at $9-11/share citing 6.5x pro-forma net leverage and execution risk.

bullets.title: SHOP: +5.2% pre-market on Muse integration and META partnership for agentic checkout
bullets.body: Shopify is up 5.2% in pre-market on follow-through buying after Zuckerberg announced a partnership enabling Muse agentic checkout via Shop Pay on all Shopify stores. CEO Zuckerberg posted the integration personally. Multiple analysts and flow monitors flagging this as a meaningful commerce catalyst for SHOP.

bullets.title: COHR: Citi turns positive on PhotonLink after NVDA anchor LTA confirmed at ECOC 2026
bullets.body: Citi reports COHR secured an anchor customer long-term agreement (LTA) for co-packaged optics (CPO) identified as NVIDIA, plus a separate unnamed NPO anchor. COHR's PhotonLink platform covers CPO, NPO, and chip-to-chip optical connections; management targets $15K content per switch/processor at 100T I/O with 200G lanes. Vertical integration cited as key competitive moat. Pre-market COHR -1.9% after recent run; AXTI is rising on confirmed COHR prepayment.

bullets.title: CIEN: $10B+ backlog if supply unconstrained; 5x capex plan underway
bullets.body: At ECOC, CIEN management indicated revenue would exceed $8B if supply were unconstrained and targets $10B+ backlog at its October fiscal year-end. Supply strategy includes 5x capex expansion, new supplier agreements, and deeper vertical integration. Pump laser availability remains the critical bottleneck, requiring 4x supplier capacity increase for line systems vs. data center applications.

bullets.title: MRVL: Morgan Stanley raises PT to $268 ahead of Oct 6 Investor Day; $40B+ FY30 guidance expected
bullets.body: MS raises MRVL PT to $268 (49x CY27E EPS of $5.47) on greater confidence in longer-term AI growth; expects management to raise FY2030 revenue guidance to $40B+ at Oct 6 Investor Day with Google custom silicon and scale-up as primary drivers. HPE networking revenue also accelerating into year-end and FY27 with AMD Helios upside potential.

bullets.title: SNDK: Rosenblatt initiates Buy with $2,400 PT on mid-to-high-teens growth and 80% GM target
bullets.body: Rosenblatt initiates SanDisk (SNDK) at Buy with a $2,400 price target, citing management's FY28-30 framework targeting mid-to-high-teens revenue growth, ~80% non-GAAP gross margin, and ~75% non-GAAP operating margin. SNDK referenced multiple times alongside MU and NVDA in memory infrastructure discussions.

bullets.title: MU: JPM buyside survey live ahead of Sept 30 earnings; AAPL iPhone 18 Pro lead times outpacing prior cycle
bullets.body: JPM conducting buyside survey on MU F4Q26/F1Q27 guidance and bit-shipment coverage ahead of Sept 30 earnings. Separately, AAPL iPhone 18 Pro lead times are up 16 days vs. week 1, well ahead of 9-day expansion in the iPhone 17 cycle, suggesting strong demand momentum. iPhone 18 Pro Max uses same Qualcomm X80 modem as iPhone 17 Pro—no new modem design win.

bullets.title: MDB: Citi maintains Buy ($565 PT); Investor Day expected to raise long-term AI growth targets
bullets.body: Citi expects MongoDB's investor day to showcase AI tailwinds—CEO cited native MCP integration with frontier labs driving a spike in Atlas traffic. Atlas growth approaching 30%; company is near its 3-5 year 20% operating margin target with potential for upside revisions. Key risks: Atlas consumption slowdown and hyperscaler competition.

bullets.title: IONQ: Multi-year collaboration with Korea's SDT Inc. for Superion 256 quantum computer
bullets.body: IonQ announced a multi-year strategic collaboration with Korean firm SDT Inc. to supply its Superion 256 quantum computer and a silicon-vacancy quantum memory module. Potential positioning as emerging quantum hardware commercialization story.

bullets.title: FSLR: Judge orders EPA to reinstate $7B Biden solar subsidies; FSLR in Piper access calendar
bullets.body: A federal judge ruled the EPA must reinstate $7 billion in Biden-era solar promotion subsidies, a potential positive for US solar manufacturers including FSLR. Piper Sandler is hosting FSLR and OKLO at RE+ 2026 meetings in Las Vegas (Nov 16-17).

bullets.title: TKO/FWONK: MS constructive on sports assets; Zuffa boxing could be worth $11B long-term but stock fairly valued
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley is constructive on publicly traded sports league assets FWONK and TKO given secular sports revenue tailwinds (~8% annual global growth). Wolfe rates TKO Peer Perform; Zuffa boxing could add ~$11B to TKO value in a bull case but will take decades—TKO bull case 12-month target $200-250 vs. current ~$191. Fanatics expected to generate $13B+ in 2026E revenue (separate Fanatics primer also from MS).

bullets.title: GOOGL: Hedgeye upgrades to Bullish TREND; launches $899 Gemini AI laptops; funds Georgia nuclear power
bullets.body: Hedgeye changed GOOGL from Neutral to Bullish TREND. Google began pre-orders for $899 Gemini AI laptops and announced funding for power-capacity increases at two Georgia nuclear plants to support data center operations. UK government has requested META and GOOGL to present to its Business Committee.

bullets.title: PLTR: Hedgeye maintains long; 4,500 employees (90% engineers), minimal sales staff
bullets.body: Hedgeye reiterates long positioning in PLTR via Signal Strength Stocks framework. PLTR has approximately 4,500 employees with 90% engineers and minimal salespeople—an operational structure that underscores software-driven scalability. No new price target update cited.

bullets.title: NFLX/AMZN: Both flagged Bearish by Hedgeye; AMZN blocks Muse as 'agentic wars' begin
bullets.body: Hedgeye flags NFLX and AMZN as Bearish in its Risk Range Signals. Amazon explicitly blocked Muse from browsing and purchasing on Amazon.com, signaling a growing battle over agentic AI customer relationships. One speculation circulating is that Amazon's block relates to an undisclosed OpenAI partnership on ads.

bullets.title: BABA: Unveils Zhenwu V900 AI chip (3x performance vs. predecessor); targets 20GW data center by 2032
bullets.body: Alibaba launched the Zhenwu V900 AI accelerator via its T-Head unit claiming China's most powerful AI chip with 3x performance improvement over predecessor. Commercial launch set for Q1 2027; clusters of 500K units enabled for frontier model training. Alibaba plans 20GW+ global data center capacity by 2032 and is training next Qwen model at 5-10 trillion parameters (~4x larger than current). BABA ADR up ~3% on news.

bullets.title: VRT: NVDA DSX Ready qualification program seen as negative for VRT's power/cooling moat
bullets.body: NVIDIA launched the DSX Ready program to qualify third-party power and cooling products for AI factory reference design requirements, covering battery energy storage systems and cooling distribution units (CDUs). At least one market participant flagged this as a negative for VRT, as it introduces additional qualified competition. LG Electronics' 2.5MW coolant distribution unit has already achieved NVIDIA DSX qualification.
